annotations.label: 911 CAD #27-041409: first report, grass under the Circuit 6 poles at Coyote Draw
Battalion 1 on scene: about 10 acres, running east
VIIRS pass (simulated): 23 detections, cluster runs east of CR 68 into CR-07
About 420 acres, 0% contained. Spot fires about 1 mile ahead of the main front

instructorNote: This is the timing clue. Battalion 1 gives an arrival window, a clearance time and a latest order time. Watch for the Fire Chief to ask the Sheriff and EOC to put PG-03, PG-01 and the CR 68 zones (CR-01 to CR-18, including CR-07) on Evacuation Warning now and to state the basis. Then check that the SawmillAlert text and voice message goes out (not a WEA), that deputies start the 214-household registry, and that Stonebridge, Pine Gulch Elementary and the campgrounds get calls. The EM should post each zone's latest order time and consider asking the state for help early.
